note: The tutorial library, in the order they're made. 'start' is where the recording begins (demo pages only). 'hint' tells the step writer where the feature lives. 'caution' is a rule the video must follow. Status lives in queue.json on the tutorials-data branch.

topics.title: Host Mode, Big Screen, and Guest Experience
Starting Live Trivia
topics.hint: Console → Live → Trivia → Go live. Show the guest phone answering (games.html?e=DEMO) and the big screen (#screen).

topics.title: Connecting and Using the Big Screen
topics.hint: The dashboard's Big screen button or the console; the big screen page is games.html?e=DEMO#screen.
topics.caution: Host Mode has no casting feature: say to open the big screen link in the TV's, projector laptop's or smart TV's web browser.

topics.title: Managing Guest Check-In
topics.hint: Console → Tonight → Guest list: check people in at the door.

topics.title: Inviting Guests to Participate
topics.hint: Console → Event → Links has the guest link and QR code.
topics.caution: Invitations and RSVPs live in a separate invite app: only show joining the games by link or QR code.

topics.title: Games and Leaderboards
topics.hint: Console tabs Live, Teams and Scores; the big screen shows the leaderboard.

topics.title: Displaying Photos and Special Moments
topics.hint: Console → Moments: show Cake; the photo slideshow starts on the big screen.

topics.title: Managing Presentations and Toasts
topics.hint: Console → Presentations: slides on the big screen, the presenter's phone is the remote.

topics.title: Understanding the Event Timeline
topics.hint: Console → Tonight: the run of show with times; Up next on Live.

topics.title: Using the Event Checklist
topics.hint: The Plan screen's To-dos tab: due dates and reminders.

topics.title: Managing Your Event Budget
topics.hint: The Plan screen's Budget tab.
topics.caution: Host Mode only tracks money. It never takes or sends payments.

topics.title: Adding and Managing Guests
topics.hint: The Plan screen's guest tab, and Console → Tonight → Guest list (import from a spreadsheet).

topics.title: Creating Seating Arrangements
topics.hint: The Plan screen's seating tab.

topics.title: Organizing Food and Dietary Requirements
topics.hint: The Plan screen's food tab; allergies.

topics.title: Tracking Vendors and Payments
topics.hint: The Plan screen's Vendors tab: deposits and balances.
topics.caution: Host Mode only records payments. It never takes or sends money.

topics.title: Stay and Go: Group Travel
topics.hint: Dashboard → Stay & Go: reservations, traveling party, shared costs, receipts and payments, guest messages.
topics.caution: Host Mode only records payments; guest messages open in the host's own email or texting app.

topics.title: Practicing with Rehearsal
topics.hint: Console → Event → Rehearsal runs the night with pretend guests.

topics.title: Adding Moderators
topics.hint: Console → Event → Moderators: give a helper their own PIN.
topics.caution: Never show a real PIN; demo PINs only, and don't read them aloud.

topics.title: Menu and Drink Orders
topics.hint: Console → Menu: guests see the menu and order food and drinks.

topics.title: Making Custom Games
topics.hint: Console → Custom games: create one or add from the library, then test it.

topics.title: Creating Shared Photo Albums
topics.hint: Console → Memories: the shared photo album.

topics.title: Collecting Guest Photos and Wishes
topics.hint: Guests add photos and wishes from their phone; the host sees them in Console → Memories.

topics.title: Creating Event Keepsakes
topics.hint: Console → Memories: the keepsake.

topics.title: Getting Started as an Event Planner
topics.hint: The planner portal: Home shows what needs attention; the tabs along the top.

topics.title: Creating Client Portals
topics.hint: Clients tab: add a client; each client gets a private portal link.

topics.title: Using Reusable Event Templates
topics.hint: Templates tab.

topics.title: Managing Client Approvals
topics.hint: Clients → open a client → send a menu, floor plan or design; they tap Approve or Request changes.

topics.title: Coordinating the Event Team
topics.hint: Teammates tab: add teammates, schedule shifts; Branding → Day-of mode.
topics.caution: Shifts track pay only; Host Mode never pays anyone.

topics.title: Tracking Planner Payments and Vendors
topics.hint: Clients → open a client → Money and Vendors; invoices and packages.
topics.caution: Host Mode only records payments; card payments and sending email aren't available yet.

topics.title: Tracking Inventory
topics.hint: Inventory tab: items, reserve for an event, pull lists, check out and in.

topics.title: Venue Bookings and Blocked Days
topics.hint: Venue tab: spaces, holds, confirmed bookings, Block off days.
